work.permit: Autorisation individuelle préalable du ministre ayant le Travail dans ses attributions

note: Read on Legilux, the Journal officiel's site (rendered with Playwright, as the site is a JavaScript application; its consolidated versions say they have no legal value and are documentary). Majority: 18, Code civil art. 488: of full age at eighteen accomplished, capable of all acts of civil life. Emancipation (by marriage or by the juge des tutelles) isn't held. Work: 15. Code du travail L. 342-1 bars the employment of 'enfants', whom L. 341-1 defines as those under fifteen or still subject to compulsory schooling, so the age is 15 where schooling has ended; those still at school are children whatever their age, and holiday work by pupils and students (its own law) and the domestic and educational exceptions of L. 342-3 aren't held. Performers: L. 342-4 bars children's paid or professional participation in audiovisual, cultural, artistic, sporting, advertising and fashion activities, but the minister for Labour may grant an autorisation individuelle préalable on the organiser's written request with the legal representative's written consent, after the opinions of the director of the ITM and the ministers for Education, Vocational Training and Family; none for variety shows or cabarets; the child must be at least six (the minister may derogate from the age on the Family minister's, the ITM's and a doctor's opinion), not after 23:00, with 14 hours' rest between participations and pay into a blocked savings account: the derogation, hours and savings aren't held. Service: none. The Armée's own site says it has had its present form of a volunteer army for more than half a century (compulsory service ended in 1967).

sources.title: Legilux: Code civil (version consolidée), art. 488
sources.said: La majorité est fixée à dix-huit ans accomplis; à cet âge, on est capable de tous les actes de la vie civile.

sources.title: Legilux: Code du travail (version consolidée), art. L. 341-1, L. 342-1, L. 342-4
sources.said: «enfants»: tous jeunes qui n’ont pas atteint l’âge de quinze ans ou qui sont encore soumis à l’obligation scolaire imposée par la législation applicable ... Il est interdit d’employer des enfants au sens de l’article L. 341-1 à des travaux d’une nature quelconque ... une autorisation individuelle préalable peut être délivrée par le ministre ayant le Travail dans ses attributions ... Aucune autorisation ne peut être délivrée pour des spectacles de variétés ou cabarets. ... ils doivent être âgés d’au moins six ans
